feature: Ask is the design's hero button
summary: The Ask button in the title bar is now the design language's hero pill: a blue to violet spectrum with white words, a gloss along the top and a violet bloom underneath. Hover opens the spectrum toward pink, grows the bloom and sweeps one sheen across; while the Ask box is open it stays coloured and reads as held down.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/ask-hero-button-walk.json.

try.do: Open any picture and look at the top right of the title bar.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Rest the pointer on Ask and watch one light sheen cross it, left to right.
Keep the pointer there: the pill stays pinker and brighter, and the sheen does not come back.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click Ask: the Ask box opens and the pill stays coloured, pressed in, its bloom tucked.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Escape and compare the pill with the design.
Open a video: Ask drops its key and sits the usual gap from View and Edit.

evaluate: Does Ask now read as the one control up there that is different in kind, without shouting?
Is the sheen the right speed and brightness, or would you want it softer?
Does the violet bloom under the pill look right on your title bar, or does it smudge the panel below it?
Is 24 points tall right in a 28 point title bar, or should it be the design's 28?
measured: Pill colours, live capture converted to sRGB, 5pt in from each end at mid height: left #7C88FF, right #BD70FE. The design's 120 degree line puts #7887FF and #BB70FF there (12% and 88% of the way from #6E8BFF to #C56CFF), so both ends are within 4 of the design in every channel. The old pill measured #202429 at both ends.

Word contrast on the live pill (white on the colour behind it, sRGB): Ask 3.0:1 at rest, 2.9:1 hovered and open; the key 3.0:1 at rest, 2.7:1 hovered and open, where it sits on the pink end. The app's legibility check passes all seven poses (white on a vivid colour of another family needs 2:1).

Sheen: the frame 0.10s into the hover differs from the settled hover by a mean of 7.9 / 16.6 / 0.2 per channel over the pill; the old button had no sweep at all (0). Rest against settled hover: about 33 / 9 / 11.
Size: 87 by 24 points, measured from its own words and sparkle. Your design picture measures 85.5 by 24 points; the old pill was a typed-in 76 wide.
rough: The reel and the sheen contact sheet are the shipped drawing rendered offscreen at every 60th of a second, not a film of the window: the walk's film steps leave the title bar out and a snapshot lands after the 0.66s sweep has ended. The walk does prove the pointer reaches the button's hover.

Chose 24 points tall over the mock CSS's 28px (lang-frame.html, .askbtn) because your design picture of 2026-10-24 measures 24 points tall (171 by 48 pixels at 2x) and the app's title bar is itself 28 points; the panel toggle beside it is 24 too.

The key is full white, a lighter weight and a size smaller than the word, where the mock's .kbd is 70% white: at 70% it takes on the pink behind it and fails the app's legibility check. Settled by your call on 2026-09-30 (never white on white, legible always).

The bloom spills past the title bar onto whatever is under it, as the design draws it; on a video in Edit, where Ask already sits over the panel, it tints the panel's top row a little. That overlap is on-a-video-the-ask-button-never-sits-on-top-of-t.
Keyboard focus draws the violet ring (see the poses sheet), but a title bar button only takes focus with Full Keyboard Access on, so it was checked on the drawing, not live.
The Ask box's own send button stays the system's blue button: the design allows one hero per surface, and the title bar's is the one that opens the agent.
The sparkle matches the mock: one large and one small four point star, drawn from the mock's own ic-sparkle outline (the old button used the system's three star symbol).
